decisions.reason: The naval vessel lighting system builds on the firm's long-standing robust and specialist lighting expertise and its certified testing facilities, so it fits a niche where the firm's existing knowledge lets it interpret results and refine the product.

As a second-generation general interior luminaire, it sits at the core of the firm's established LED and light-management knowledge, so it is easy to absorb and improve, although its move from a dedicated page to a simple mention suggests slightly lower prominence.

The microprismatic pendant is the firm's flagship and was highlighted in 2024, and it draws directly on its in-house optics research and ergonomic office-lighting know-how, making it central to its direction.

The marine searchlight uses the firm's marine-lighting competence and remains listed, but the sister HMI searchlight has already been withdrawn, which points to some portfolio pruning in this narrow, less core segment.
